thread:
oncall-bot: Paging eng-sre on-call: P1 alert from streaming-proxy: repeated websocket disconnects for tenant ZenithCorp on their VPC gateway. Errors spike at 22:07 UTC, connection resets + 502/504 from app gateway. Auto-escalation to oncall.

jamal_r: saw the alert, I'm looking. Are we seeing an upstream error or our proxy dropping frames?

luca_infra: initial logs show a backlog on dedicated pool z-02; KV cache stalls and the stream broker is returning 504 on the first downstream read. Could be retry amplification from Zenith's app gateway.

maria_custsuccess: pinged Zenith SRE (cc @zenith_integration_bot). Their team is seeing repeated client reconnects and aggressive retry logic; they reported 5xx responses then immediate reconnect.

zenith_integration_bot: Zenith SRE: "we increased client retries after initial 502, then saw spikes. We'll throttle retries when advised. Also we can flip to our fallback region if needed." :wave:

jamal_r: can someone paste a snippet of the proxy logs for the failing stream? I want to see the handshake + disconnect pattern.

luca_infra: paste logs:

```
2026-03-01T22:06:57Z stream-proxy zenith/conn=12345 state=OPEN
2026-03-01T22:06:58Z upstream gw-10.2.5.8 read_timeout
2026-03-01T22:06:58Z stream-proxy zenith/conn=12345 state=RETRY backoff=200ms
2026-03-01T22:06:59Z stream-proxy zenith/conn=12345 upstream=504
2026-03-01T22:06:59Z client zenith/reconnect immediate
2026-03-01T22:07:00Z stream-proxy zenith/conn=12346 state=OPEN
... repeating ...
```

luca_infra: pattern: upstream read timeouts -> client reconnects -> new connection -> exhausts pool -> more timeouts. We're hitting per-tenant concurrency limits on z-02 pool (default 64) and queue depth grows.

arthur_platform: that matches a retry storm. Mitigations: 1) ask customer to throttle retries 2) widen timeouts on our VPC gateway temporarily 3) isolate Zenith to a reserved slice on another pool or reduce their concurrency cap so storms are backpressured at gateway.

jamal_r: immediate action: enable graceful backpressure and increase WS idle timeout. I can push a dynamic change to gateway config for Zenith: stream_timeout=90s (was 30s) and aggressive retry-circuit (max_attempts=3 with exponential backoff). This should reduce reconnects. Also enable per-tenant token bucket to limit new connection rate to 10/s.

luca_infra: I'm preparing the change. Patch preview:

```
# dynamic patch for tenant ZenithCorp
tenant: ZenithCorp
stream: {
  stream_timeout: "90s",
  max_concurrent_streams: 48,
  connection_rate_limit: 10
}
retry_policy: {
  max_attempts: 3,
  backoff_ms: [500, 1000, 2000]
}
```

maria_custsuccess: Maria to Zenith: we'll apply a temporary config and coordinate a controlled restart window. ETA 5m for patch, we'll notify you before the change. We also recommend you throttle retries client-side to 1/s.

zenith_integration_bot: Zenith SRE: "Acknowledged. We'll reduce client retries to 1/s immediately and hold fallback region until you tell us to switch." :thumbsup:

jamal_r: running the patch now (will apply only to tenant routing, no full cluster restart). I will monitor metrics and open a short-lived canary route on z-03 to shift 20% traffic if timeouts persist.

oncall-bot: deploybot: applying dynamic tenant config for ZenithCorp to pool z-02

luca_infra: change applied. Confirming stream_timeout=90s and rate_limit=10 on proxy. Per-tenant concurrency dropped to 48. Creating canary route 20% -> z-03.

jamal_r: I'm seeing decreased connection churn and fewer upstream 504s immediately. Client reconnects reduced by ~60% in last 2m.

arthur_platform: good. Next steps: 1) keep canary for 30m 2) set automatic rollback if error_rate > 2% or queue_depth > threshold 3) schedule dedicated pool slice for Zenith (they pay for reserved capacity). I'll start a ticket for traffic isolation.

maria_custsuccess: I'll update the customer with current findings and mitigation. Propose we offer a short-term reserved capacity (a few GPUs) while they stabilize retry logic.

jamal_r: small note — we saw a client that didn't back off and still hammered reconnects. I pushed a temporary ingress circuit breaker to drop IPs which exceed 30 connects/min to protect pool.

luca_infra: added IP-based throttling at the edge as emergency measure. Details in runbook: /runbooks/streaming/retry-storm.md :point_left: (we should copy key steps to the incident summary later).

oncall-bot: Incident note: INC-20260301-17 created, severity P1, owners: jamal_r (eng-sre), luca_infra (eng-infra), arthur_platform (eng-platform). Paging channels updated.

maria_custsuccess: Zenith ops confirmed degradation resolved on their side after throttle. They report a small window of failed messages but acceptable. Will follow up with postmortem request.

arthur_platform: assign follow-ups: - Capacity: provision reserved slice for Zenith (ticket + cost calc) - Product: discuss client-side retry best practices in integration docs - Eng: permanent config change to per-tenant backpressure and observability (per-tenant queue metrics).

jamal_r: handing off to luca_infra for next-hour mitigation and cleanup. I'll stay on standby for escalation. luca, please post when you hand back.

luca_infra: acknowledged. I'll drain the canary in 30m and begin reservation ticket. Handing to on-call night team at 23:45 UTC. :white_check_mark:

maria_custsuccess: I'll schedule a customer call for a 1h post-incident debrief with Zenith tomorrow and include remediation plan.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please attach logs and the dynamic patch diff to INC-20260301-17 and mark any customer-facing notes. Incident will be tracked for SLA impact assessment.

jamal_r: adding quick reproduction snippet for devs who'll iterate on permanent fixes (simulate client retry storm):

```
# simulate streaming reconnects
for i in $(seq 1 200); do 
  curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://vpc-gateway.redwood.net/stream/zenith" &
  sleep 0.1
done
```

arthur_platform: thanks team. We'll keep the incident open until postmortem and reserved capacity is provisioned. Closing active mitigation — handing to follow-up owners. :lock:

luca_infra: handoff complete at 23:45 UTC. I'll post final status and ticket numbers in this thread when created.

maria_custsuccess: noted. Closing customer update loop for now. Will reopen if Zenith reports any recurrence.
